categories.parameter binding: Exact argument slot one enters its resolved target and selected call context.
categories.caller argument binding: A formal sink expands to its caller argument slot one without an initially selected callee frame; exact resolved target identity is checked.
categories.unchanged argument output: The identity parameter is unchanged; this conservative argument-output route is distinct from the scalar return and does not establish String mutation. localConstantResult excludes old input when the return replacement is independent.
categories.argument output binding: Output slot one returns to the exact selected caller argument, with its output flag and caller context retained.
categories.parameter use: The parameter supplies a value use in the same method.
categories.storage write: The actual setter assignment uses the RHS in argument slot two; field declaration code is not the stored value.
categories.exceptional memory effect exit: Stored state crosses a failed call or resumed thrown exit; this is not an exception payload or scalar return dependency.
categories.resolved call exit: The method identity matches the resolved caller target; void setters/helpers carry memory effects, getters/read return scalar values.
categories.storage continuation: Invisible entry evidence resumes CFG storage traversal at the selected caller; completed unrelated-slot cleanup does not kill the requested slot.
categories.method exit evidence: Return/normal completion carries stored state or the scalar getter/helper value.
categories.returned value: The getter/read value supplies its explicit return operand.
categories.assignment or use: Source/evaluation temporary storage supplies a later use without reevaluation.
categories.saved scalar result: The resolved getter/helper return supplies a saved RHS or caught-result temporary.

limitations: DART-FLOW-008 original local normal-return false positive is rejected. All four negative queries have matching same-source positive controls and recorded budgets; other query limits still make these absence observations inconclusive.

Normal/caught local and loop copies retain the correct pending demand. localBoth queries share a source and invocation. localPriorResult consumes its later normal demand before following an earlier handled thrown cleanup; localReplacementResult needs no pending demand because its cleanup return replaces the exit.

The native oracle executes three inputs and both booleans. It establishes observed local/field values, loop behavior, handled prior cleanup and return replacement; it is not proof over arbitrary executions.

Complete returned transitions and task demands are retained; CFG search histories are not complete execution traces. Initialization-state correlation, implicit/external effects, cross-context values, predicate feasibility and general heap/lifecycle qualification remain open.
